issues.message: Classification means biological taxonomy in one context and scientific grouping skill in the other. Keep distinct concept IDs.
Thermodynamics is shared physics/chemistry knowledge. A reusable concept graph may link these, but neither legacy record is removed.
Animal-wide nervous, reflex, circulatory and excretory concepts sit under Human Body. Preserve original chapter and add proposed Animal Biology classification after review.
Named reactions sits under Qualitative Analysis. Link to Named organic reactions and review broader named inorganic reactions before moving.
Real life examples does not identify an optical concept; preserve and request specific applications.
Speed of movement of coil needs motor parameters and model assumptions.
Circulation and excretion are combined; split into linked child concepts after review.
Every original record repeats the same four generic subtopic labels. These are content scaffolding, not actual concept-specific subtopics.
Legacy visuals lists 2D, 3D, Watch, Simulate for all records; this is retained inventory intent, not feature availability. Runtime availability must use implementation registry.

Official PDF course table includes Effects of Current and Heredity content, while page 6 note broadly excludes certain topics from year-end examination. Assessment scope is not inferred; seek board clarification.
